intent: reduce latency by shrinking the image
hypothesis: Sending a smaller image to a VLM reduces inference time.
method: Same frame at 1920x1080, Canny edge map at 1920x1080, and downscaled to 240x135. min of 3 warm runs each, moondream via ollama.
mechanism: A fixed-input VLM resizes every image to a fixed tensor (~378x378 for moondream) before any work. File decode is microseconds against ~400ms of inference. A tiny image is upscaled back into blur, which makes the model hedge and emit more tokens.
generalizes_to: Any fixed-input vision model. Image compression buys storage and bandwidth, never latency.
if_you_were_about_to: Downscale or compress frames to speed up inference. Do not. Measure latency against pixel count first; you will likely find there is nothing there.

intent: use edge detection to reduce data
apply a classical filter before the VLM
posterize or threshold to simplify the image
send a line drawing instead of a photo
hypothesis: A cheap classical filter reduces an image to something still recognizable but cheaper.
method: One lit frame and one dim frame (mean 0.235) through grayscale, downscale, posterize, k-means quantize, cartoon, Canny, Sobel, adaptive threshold. Described by moondream with an identical prompt.

measurement.lit_canny: A black and white line drawing of a living room with a couch, chair, potted plant, and window.
measurement.dark_unfiltered: urns on the table and shelf, lamp with white shade, flat screen tv displaying a video game, and a green dinosaur statue
measurement.dark_canny: urns on the table and floor
measurement.dark_clahe_plus_edges: ...and a person standing near the window (NO PERSON PRESENT)
measurement.lit_sobel: ...a person can be seen sitting on a chair near one of these windows (NO PERSON PRESENT)

mechanism: An edge map is not a compressed scene; it is a different kind of image, and the model reports it as a drawing. On low-contrast input the filters remove the little signal present, and the model fills the deficit with a human figure.
generalizes_to: Pre-processing that uniformly discards information. The two filters that discarded the most are the two that hallucinated people.
if_you_were_about_to: Run edge detection or thresholding before a VLM to save resources. Do not. Feed the model the frame. Edges are useful as a GATE (where/whether to spend a call), never as the input.

hypothesis: There is a bit depth below 8 that is sufficient for scene description.
method: Uniform quantization to 8/4/3/2/1 bits per channel plus grayscale variants, on a lit frame (mean 0.509) and a dim frame (mean 0.235).

measurement.lit_1bit_per_channel: a beige couch sits against this wall, accompanied by a bookshelf filled with various items (CORRECT, 133KB, 21x reduction)
measurement.dark_8bit: a flat screen TV displaying a video game with a controller resting on it
measurement.dark_2bit: a television screen displaying a blank screen (CONTENT LOST)
measurement.dark_1bit: urns on a table and lamp with yellow shade (TV LOST ENTIRELY)
measurement.mid_1bit: chair behind person sitting down (NO PERSON PRESENT)
measurement.lit_grey_2bit: a black and white photo of a person sitting on the couch (NO PERSON PRESENT)

verdict: CONDITIONAL. There is no single safe bit depth.
mechanism: Quantization tolerance is a function of scene contrast, not a constant. A high-contrast scene survives losing 7 of 8 bits. A dim one does not, and when starved it hallucinates people rather than degrading gracefully.
generalizes_to: Any uniform quantization of perceptual input. If you must do it, key the depth to a measured per-frame contrast or brightness statistic, never a constant.
if_you_were_about_to: Pick a global bit depth. Do not. Note also that bit depth cannot buy latency (see F01), so the only payoff is storage.

intent: tune JPEG quality against description quality
hypothesis: A single run per condition is enough to compare VLM output quality.
method: Identical image, identical JPEG quality, identical prompt, five consecutive runs.

measurement.run_1: urns on a shelf and a lamp next to it
measurement.run_2: urns on a shelf next to a television screen and a lamp with a white shade.

verdict: CRITICAL METHODOLOGY FAILURE. n=1 is not a measurement.
mechanism: One run in five dropped a major object from an identical input. Run-to-run variance equals or exceeds most preprocessing effects, so single-sample comparisons measure noise.
generalizes_to: All qualitative VLM evaluation. An earlier version of this work concluded JPEG q8 beat q85 on a dark frame; that was one sample of a coin flip and was wrong.
if_you_were_about_to: Conclude anything from one VLM output per condition. Use n>=5. Separately: a single glance is a coin flip on whether a major object exists, so when it matters, look twice (0.4s, turns a 20% miss into ~4%).

intent: set exposure or zoom or resolution
hypothesis: A camera control that accepts a value and reads it back has applied it.
method: Set each control, capture frames, compare pixels against the unset state and against a simulation of the intended effect.

measurement.isOpened: returned True while the camera had been dead for six days
measurement.capture_3840x2160: negotiated and logged successfully, returned partially-decoded MJPG
measurement.exposure_time_absolute_300_to_2500: frame mean 0.2112 -> 0.2101; control was flagged inactive because auto_exposure overrode it

zoom_absolute_100_to_150.note: 2.70 grey levels is sensor noise between consecutive frames

verdict: FOUR CONTROLS REPORTED SUCCESS AND DID NOTHING.
mechanism: UVC drivers expose controls the firmware may ignore. Readback reflects the driver's stored value, not the sensor's behaviour. Controls can also be silently inactive because another control overrides them (check the flags field).
generalizes_to: Every hardware abstraction. A control's own readback is not evidence that it did anything.
if_you_were_about_to: Believe a camera control, or report its value to a downstream agent. Verify against pixels first. A false sensor belief handed to an agent is worse than a missing capability, because the agent will reason confidently from it.

intent: crop at higher resolution for detail
hypothesis: Crops are starved below the model's input size (~378px), so raising capture resolution should improve cropped reads.
method: Same bookshelf, same light, cropped from a 1920x1080 frame (269x573 px) and a 2560x1440 frame (359x764 px). n=5 each.

measurement.1080p: The image shows a bookshelf filled with various items including several books and a vase of flowers on the top shelf.
measurement.1440p: The image shows a bookshelf filled with various items including several books and a vase of flowers on the top shelf.

mechanism: The ceiling is the model's SEMANTIC resolution, not the frame's optical resolution. moondream reads 'bookshelf with books' from gross structure and cannot read a spine at any resolution. More pixels do not produce more meaning.
generalizes_to: Any attempt to buy comprehension with acuity. Check whether your model is optically limited or semantically limited before spending on sensors.
if_you_were_about_to: Raise sensor resolution to improve descriptions. Measure first; you are probably semantically bound. The exception not yet tested here is TEXT, where detail does convert to meaning.

intent: send a simplified or symbolic image
use a diagram or icon instead of a photo
compress an image to its essential strokes
hypothesis: A maximally compressed symbolic drawing (one circle, five lines) conveys 'person' cheaply.
method: Drew a stick figure, a house, and two stick figures. 5.6KB each. Four different prompts.

measurement.this_is_a_line_drawing_what_does_it_depi: a black and white stick figure standing upright ... on its hind legs

verdict: REFUTED. It reaches the genre label and never arrives at 'person'.
mechanism: A stick figure is a PROTOCOL, not a compression. Five strokes carry almost nothing; a human receiver supplies the content from an involuntary body-schema detector. A VLM trained on captioned photographs has no such decoder, so line drawings are out of distribution.
generalizes_to: Every compression scheme is a bet about the receiver. Schemes tuned for human perception do not transfer to models trained on photographs.
if_you_were_about_to: Simplify or stylize input for a model on the grounds that humans find it legible. Legibility is receiver-specific.

intent: set a quality threshold on images
hypothesis: Row-mean jitter detects partially-decoded MJPG frames.
method: Computed mean absolute difference between consecutive row means at 1080p, 1440p and 2160p.

measurement.note: the metric DECREASES with resolution because more rows means smaller adjacent differences

verdict: THE METRIC DOES NOT TRANSFER ACROSS RESOLUTIONS.
mechanism: A threshold calibrated at one resolution is meaningless at another. The author nearly concluded 4K was clean from a 0.25 reading against a threshold derived at 1080p. Ground truth was looking at the image.
generalizes_to: Any statistic whose scale depends on input dimensions. Recalibrate per resolution or normalize, and keep a human-visible ground truth.
if_you_were_about_to: Reuse an image-quality threshold after changing capture resolution. Recalibrate it.

intent: the scene is too dim to read
the model cannot see detail in shadow
hypothesis: A dim, low-detail scene needs better exposure, more gain, or more light.
method: Swept every ACTIVE UVC control on the camera against a fixed dark bookshelf crop at 2560x1440, same light, seconds apart. n=3 descriptions per condition plus objective brightness, contrast and Laplacian sharpness.

backlight_compensation_2.text: three shelves and is made of metal

measurement.exposure_time_absolute: FLAGGED INACTIVE — auto_exposure overrides it; an earlier session tested only this and wrongly concluded the category was a dead end

verdict: CONFIRMED, and the single largest gain in two days of work. 4.3x brightness, 2.4x sharpness, 35x fewer blown-out pixels.
mechanism: A backlit scene (bright windows, dark interior) saturates a fifth of the frame to pure white while crushing the subject. backlight_compensation is the control for exactly this and it was at its minimum. It is NOT a trade of highlights for shadows — it recovered both ends simultaneously.
generalizes_to: Check every ACTIVE control before concluding a scene is unfixable, and check the FLAGS field — a control can be silently inactive because another overrides it. Classical camera controls are where the gains are; no amount of model or pixel work recovers information the sensor threw away.
if_you_were_about_to: Add a model, raise resolution, or buy a better camera because images look dark. Sweep the UVC controls first. This one control beat every optical and algorithmic lever in this entire corpus combined, and it costs nothing.
